areas.left_bank: The centre and south (Admiralty, Liteyny, Smolny, Moscow and Narva districts)
areas.fortress: Hare Island (the Peter and Paul Fortress)

nikolaevsky_station.name: Nikolaevsky Station
nikolaevsky_station.note: Trains to Moscow - and the Northern line to Vologda and Murmansk.

warsaw_station.name: Warsaw Station
warsaw_station.note: Trains south-west: Gatchina, Luga, Pskov and the Northern Front.

baltic_station.name: Baltic Station
baltic_station.note: Trains to Oranienbaum, Narva and Reval.

vitebsk_station.name: Tsarskoe Selo Station
vitebsk_station.note: Trains to Tsarskoe Selo, Dno and the south.

neva_quays.name: English Embankment quays
neva_quays.note: Where ships from Kronstadt tie up - the Aurora's berth is upriver.

general_staff.name: General Staff building (Military District HQ)
general_staff.note: Headquarters of the Petrograd Military District, across Palace Square from the Winter Palace.

state_bank.name: State Bank
state_bank.note: On Sadovaya Street; the treasury's vaults.

franco_russian_works.name: Franco-Russian Works
franco_russian_works.note: Shipyard on the Neva where the cruiser Aurora is under repair.

strelka.name: The Strelka (Stock Exchange)
strelka.note: The point of Vasilievsky Island facing the Winter Palace.

university.name: Petrograd University
university.note: The Twelve Collegia; students and lecture halls.

baltic_shipyard.name: Baltic Shipyard
baltic_shipyard.note: Big naval yard; a Bolshevik stronghold.

kshesinskaya_mansion.name: Kshesinskaya Mansion
kshesinskaya_mansion.note: The Bolsheviks' headquarters until July; now held by the government.

arsenal.name: Petrograd Arsenal
arsenal.note: Arms works on the Vyborg embankment.

okhta.name: Okhta
okhta.note: Workers' district across the Neva from the Smolny; the Okhta powder works.

kronstadt.name: Kronstadt
kronstadt.note: Island naval base of the Baltic Fleet.

oranienbaum.name: Oranienbaum
oranienbaum.note: Rail terminus and ferry for Kronstadt.

levashovo.name: Levashovo
levashovo.note: Station on the Finland line north of the city.

pulkovo.name: Pulkovo Heights
pulkovo.note: The high ground on the southern road into the city.

gatchina.name: Gatchina
gatchina.note: Junction of the Warsaw and Baltic lines south of the city.

luga.name: Luga
luga.note: On the Warsaw line toward Pskov.

dno.name: Dno
dno.note: Junction where the Tsar's train was stopped in March.

dvinsk.name: Dvinsk
dvinsk.note: Front-line fortress on the Western Dvina.

riga.name: Riga
riga.note: Taken by the Germans in late August.

narva.name: Narva
narva.note: On the Baltic line to Reval.

beloostrov.name: Beloostrov
beloostrov.note: Border station with the Grand Duchy of Finland.

terijoki.name: Terijoki
terijoki.note: Finnish resort town on the line to Vyborg.

helsingfors.name: Helsingfors
helsingfors.note: Capital of Finland; Baltic Fleet base. Lenin is hiding here.

mga.name: Mga
mga.note: Junction on the line east to Vologda.

zvanka.name: Zvanka
zvanka.note: Where the Murmansk line leaves the Vologda line.

murmansk.name: Murmansk
murmansk.note: Ice-free port at the end of the line; Allied supplies.

vologda.name: Vologda
vologda.note: Northern junction: lines to Archangel, Moscow and the Urals.

vyatka.name: Vyatka
vyatka.note: On the northern line to Perm.

chudovo.name: Chudovo
chudovo.note: On the Nikolaevsky line; branch to Novgorod.

bologoye.name: Bologoye
bologoye.note: Halfway to Moscow; junction for the line west to Dno.

moscow.name: Moscow
moscow.note: Russia's second city and railway hub.

yaroslavl.name: Yaroslavl
yaroslavl.note: On the Volga, north of Moscow.

orsha.name: Orsha
orsha.note: Junction of the Moscow-Minsk and Vitebsk-Mogilev lines.

tsaritsyn.name: Tsaritsyn
tsaritsyn.note: Volga city; grain and the road to the Caspian.

rostov.name: Rostov-on-Don
rostov.note: Gateway to the Don and the Caucasus.

novocherkassk.name: Novocherkassk
novocherkassk.note: Capital of the Don Cossacks under Ataman Kaledin.

kazan.name: Kazan
kazan.note: Volga city; the State Bank's gold reserve is stored here.

syzran.name: Syzran
syzran.note: Volga crossing on the line east.

samara.name: Samara
samara.note: Volga city on the Trans-Siberian approach.
